title: BUGFIX — cmdPipeline + cmdDiversity inflate counts from duplicate ledger entries
rationale: Same root cause as Sprint 1395/1396: publish-ledger.jsonl has multiple entries per video_id. cmdPipeline() line 490 builds unposted without dedup — inflates captionedCount display. cmdDiversity() line 802 builds ready without dedup — skews queue diversity analysis. Both need seenVids Set same as Sprint 1395/1396 pattern.

In cmdDiversity() ~line 802: add seenVids Set when filtering ready from ledger.
